meaning_of_qualification: Qualification validates the authority classification and substitution-readiness logic. It does not resolve rows marked UNRESOLVED and is not production admission.

rows.scope: Pinned Ribasim Basin state; bridge model must pin the area-level-storage relation.
rows.time_support: instantaneous Basin state at matched solver/output time
rows.comparison_rule: Compare storage at identical timestamps; do not infer storage from level without the pinned Basin relation.

rows.scope: Pinned Basin level state.
rows.time_support: instantaneous Basin state at matched solver/output time
rows.comparison_rule: Compare level directly only after datum and unit alignment.

rows.scope: Use separate UserDemand nodes when claim-specific supplied flow is needed.
rows.comparison_rule: Demand is a management request and must never be treated as supplied water.

rows.scope: Pinned allocation semantics.
rows.comparison_rule: Allocated flow remains nonphysical until realized by the physical layer.

rows.real: physical UserDemand inflow-link flow or correctly lag-aligned supplied result
rows.scope: Prefer direct per-link physical flow or separate UserDemand nodes for claim-specific comparison.
rows.time_support: physical flow integrated over the realization interval; allocation supplied output is recorded with one allocation-period lag
rows.comparison_rule: Only supplied flow enters water ledgers; align the lag before comparing allocation output rows.

rows.scope: Structural analogue only.
rows.comparison_rule: Do not compare active-set regime labels numerically as if they were the same law.

rows.scope: Restricted priority semantics; not full network fairness equivalence.
rows.comparison_rule: Compare allocation ordering separately from later physical supply reduction.

rows.scope: Pinned allocation scheduling.
rows.comparison_rule: Align allocation decision times before comparing demand or allocated values.

rows.scope: DUMMY-17 route is an exact analytical path oracle only.
rows.time_support: continuous analytical flow versus Ribasim solver flow
rows.comparison_rule: Bind a specific real routing element before numerical equality is tested.

rows.scope: Restricted F-GC prepared-solve profile only.
rows.time_support: prepared-solve candidate/end state for the coupling window
rows.comparison_rule: Pin exact cells/aggregation and compare head at the same candidate/accepted time.

rows.scope: Restricted admitted groundwater coupling profile; sign convention must be normalized.
rows.time_support: integrated over one accepted coupling window
rows.comparison_rule: Use one accepted integrated transfer with opposite signs in the two component ledgers.

rows.scope: Full storage-ledger substitution is blocked.

rows.scope: No one-to-one parameter mapping admitted.
rows.comparison_rule: Compare realized transfer response, not raw conductance parameter, unless a package-specific derivation is separately qualified.

rows.real: one prepared solve session per coupling window
rows.scope: Restricted F-GC39 service contract.

rows.comparison_rule: Do not invent per-iteration groundwater rollback when the admitted service contract does not provide it.

rows.scope: Local prepared-solve transaction only; not by itself a whole-product atomic commit.
rows.comparison_rule: Distinguish local solve finalization from product-level coupled acceptance.

rows.scope: The analytical bucket is not the production SWAP irrigation state.
rows.time_support: accepted hydrologic/crop state used for irrigation selection
rows.comparison_rule: Do not equate one aggregate root-water volume with production stress/event logic.
rows.adaptation_required: Define a production irrigation-state adapter using actual stress, crop and continuation state.

rows.scope: Production decision authority is identified, but its law differs from the analytical deficit request.
rows.comparison_rule: Compare selected event request and timing as a separate management object; do not require equality to max(0,W_target-W).
rows.adaptation_required: Use the qualified F-APP07 event law in real-SWAP bridge.

rows.scope: State definition is known; product transaction ownership is a separate unresolved row.
rows.time_support: persistent management continuation across accepted intervals
rows.comparison_rule: Track management continuation separately from hydrologic state and allocation shortfall.

rows.analytical: DUMMY-15C event-realization policy under external scarcity
rows.real: production behavior when a selected F-APP07 event cannot be fully supplied externally
rows.scope: DUMMY-15C qualifies contrast policies but does not choose production policy.
rows.time_support: selected irrigation event / coupled realization window
rows.comparison_rule: No production partial supply may be applied until event-state transition policy is explicitly admitted.

rows.real: externally supplied gross sprinkling entering Rutter path
rows.scope: Gross scheduled irrigation exists, but externally curtailed supplied gross amount lacks admitted production policy.
rows.comparison_rule: Source withdrawal must equal accepted gross supplied irrigation, not net soil irrigation.
rows.blocker: Depends on unresolved production external partial-supply policy and atomic irrigation transaction.

rows.scope: Restricted F-APP05 stateful Rutter process.
rows.comparison_rule: Include canopy storage in represented ledger or expose its delta as a boundary term.

rows.real: Rutter reservoir outflow attributable to irrigation
rows.scope: Irrigation-only/no-rain bridge; attribution becomes more complex with simultaneous rainfall.
rows.comparison_rule: For the first real bridge exclude rainfall so irrigation attribution is unambiguous.

rows.real: Rutter net_surface_irrigation bound to dynamic top
rows.scope: Restricted F-APP08 binding.
rows.comparison_rule: Net soil input is distinct from gross source withdrawal.

rows.analytical: event management state + gross supply + canopy candidate + kernel irrigation candidate accepted together
rows.scope: Legacy transaction captured dayfix/nirri, current restricted FMR/application authorities do not yet prove atomic ownership of F-APP07 + Rutter + kernel state.
rows.comparison_rule: Do not mutate irrigation continuation, canopy state or supplied irrigation independently.
rows.blocker: No inspected admitted production authority proves atomic commit/rollback of irrigation management continuation, canopy candidate and kernel physical state.

rows.scope: General production drainage outside explicitly admitted restricted profiles.
rows.comparison_rule: No analytical capacity-drainage term may be mapped onto production drainage until ownership is closed.

rows.comparison_rule: Kernel commit remains sole committed-state mutation for the state actually owned by the kernel participant.

rows.scope: Internal restricted coupling profile.
